key_findings: Chronic postoperative pain (SMIR) down-regulates hippocampal NMDAR/ERK/CREB/BDNF/TrkB signaling and PSD-95, causing spine loss and fear extinction dysfunction.
NMDA rescued extinction and spines; TrkB inhibitor ANA-12 reversed extinction memory retrieval and re-induced spine loss.
